subject.title: fix: stabilize macOS app node connection and eliminate pairing file read/write race

question: Should maintainers close this mixed branch and ask for a focused macOS-node replacement, or sponsor a cleanup of this branch down to only the node-pairing/readiness fix?
rationale: The central bug is still relevant, but the current PR is conflicting and mixes public config, installer, and contributor-workflow changes that are not safe to land under the macOS node fix.

options.title: Close and request focused replacement
options.body: Close this branch as the wrong landing base and ask for a new narrow PR that carries only the macOS node fix with real proof.

options.title: Sponsor branch cleanup
options.body: Keep the branch open only if a maintainer intends to remove the unrelated session, installer, and template changes, rebase it, and require proof.

options.title: Accept broad branch risk
options.body: Land all bundled topics together after owner approval and upgrade proof, accepting the extra compatibility and workflow risk.

recommendation.title: Close and request focused replacement
recommendation.body: Close this branch as the wrong landing base and ask for a new narrow PR that carries only the macOS node fix with real proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is currently assigned to `steipete`, and his history touches adjacent node-pairing/session surfaces relevant to the split-or-close decision.
